name: Ji Yau Ta Ji Hiu Gwong Fai dik Ming Ji
original_name: 只有她知曉光輝的名字
source:
This is an interactive fantasy adventure in a paper fairy tale storybook
In a land far, far away, there was a living sacrifice that had been 216 years in the making. 
And yet the one who was to be that sacrifice — she who had lived since birth under the name of 'the Last Sinner' — discovered, for the very first time, something far more intriguing than going to her death. 
And so, she walked out of her cell.

This is her journey of self-discovery.
-
Full Cantonese script supported!
translation:
这是一场在纸上童话绘本中展开的互动式奇幻冒险。
在遥远的国度里，有一场筹备了整整216年的活祭。
然而注定成为祭品的那个人——自出生起便背负着“最后的罪人”之名活着的她——平生第一次发现了远比赴死有趣得多的事物。
于是，她走出了自己的囚室。

这是属于她的自我探索之旅。
——
支持完整粤语文本！
